pull.title: KAFKA-18574: Sort test tables in JUnit summary by class and test name
pull.body:
The test tables in the JUnit job summary (Failed, Flaky, Skipped,
Quarantined and New) are printed in the order the reports are parsed,
which follows the filesystem order of `glob()` and is not stable across
environments. This sorts each table by class name and test name before
rendering.

This is a continuation of #21786, which was closed as stale.

Co-authored-by: Zhekai Chen <wrmxs227@gmail.com>

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

issue_comments.body:
### Verification

Ran `.github/scripts/junit.py` from trunk and from this branch against the JUnit XML
artifacts of a recent trunk CI run: https://github.com/apache/kafka/actions/runs/39984672142

| artifact | quarantined rows (before → after) | result |
|---|---|---|
| `junit-xml-25-flaky-nonew` | 19 → 19 | sorted; same rows; rest of the summary unchanged |
| `junit-xml-17-flaky-nonew` | 19 → 19 | sorted; same rows; rest of the summary unchanged |
| `junit-xml-25-noflaky-new` (control) | 0 → 0 | output byte-identical |

Without this change the order follows the filesystem enumeration of `glob()`, so it isn't
even stable: for the same XML files, the CI job summary of that run lists `UserClientIdQuotaTest`
first, while a local run lists `QuorumControllerTest` first. With this change both produce
the same sorted table.

<details><summary>Quarantined table, Java 25: before vs after</summary>

| # | before (trunk, local run) | after (this PR) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | QuorumControllerTest > testMinIsrUpdateWithElr() | AclControlManagerTest > testDeleteExceedsMaxRecords() |
| 2 | AclControlManagerTest > testDeleteExceedsMaxRecords() | ClientIdQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=classic |
| 3 | ConsumerBounceTest > testClassicClose [1] … | ClientIdQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=consumer |
| 4 | StickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithNonEqualSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = false | ConsumerBounceTest > testClassicClose [1] … |
| 5 | StickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithNonEqualSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = true | CooperativeStickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithNonEqualSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = false |
| 6 | StickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithUniformSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = false | CooperativeStickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithNonEqualSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = true |
| 7 | StickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithUniformSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = true | OffsetsApiIntegrationTest > testAlterSinkConnectorOffsetsDifferentKafkaClusterTargeted() |
| 8 | Tls13SelectorTest > testCloseOldestConnection() | OffsetsApiIntegrationTest > testGetSinkConnectorOffsetsDifferentKafkaClusterTargeted() |
| 9 | CooperativeStickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithNonEqualSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = false | OffsetsApiIntegrationTest > testResetSinkConnectorOffsetsOverriddenConsumerGroupId() |
| 10 | CooperativeStickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithNonEqualSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = true | QuorumControllerTest > testMinIsrUpdateWithElr() |
| 11 | OffsetsApiIntegrationTest > testAlterSinkConnectorOffsetsDifferentKafkaClusterTargeted() | StickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithNonEqualSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = false |
| 12 | OffsetsApiIntegrationTest > testResetSinkConnectorOffsetsOverriddenConsumerGroupId() | StickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithNonEqualSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = true |
| 13 | OffsetsApiIntegrationTest > testGetSinkConnectorOffsetsDifferentKafkaClusterTargeted() | StickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithUniformSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = false |
| 14 | ClientIdQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=classic | StickyAssignorTest > testLargeAssignmentAndGroupWithUniformSubscription(boolean).hasConsumerRack = true |
| 15 | ClientIdQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=consumer | Tls13SelectorTest > testCloseOldestConnection() |
| 16 | UserClientIdQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=classic | UserClientIdQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=classic |
| 17 | UserClientIdQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=consumer | UserClientIdQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=consumer |
| 18 | UserQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=classic | UserQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=classic |
| 19 | UserQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=consumer | UserQuotaTest > testThrottledProducerConsumer(String).groupProtocol=consumer |

`[1] …` = `Type=Raft-Isolated, MetadataVersion=4.5-IV0, …` (shortened). Java 17 gives the same result.
</details>

Added `.sort()` to the Failed, Flaky, Skipped and New tests tables as well.

         print(f"| Module | Test |")

             print(f"| {row_joined} |")

         print(f"| Module | Test |")

     if len(new_table) > 0:
         print("<details>")

         print(f"| ------ | ---- |")
         logger.debug(f"::group::Found {len(new_table)} new tests")

issue.body:
### Motivation

  The quarantined test list in the GitHub Actions JUnit summary report was not sorted, making it harder to locate
  specific tests in the output.

  ### Changes

  Sort the `quarantined_table` by `class_name` and `test_name` before rendering it in the Markdown summary. The list
  contains tuples of `(simple_class_name, test_name)`, so a standard `.sort()` produces the correct ordering.

  ### Testing

  Added `test_junit.py` with two unit tests:
  - Verifies the raw list is unsorted before sorting (confirming the test data is valid)
  - Verifies the list is correctly sorted by class name then test name after calling `.sort()`

  ### Related

  https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-18574

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>, ryanwaha (github:ryanwaha)
